name: ReengagementDelivery
description: Private server-only one-attempt delivery marker for the older inactive account reminder

owner_email.description: Normalized verified account email receiving the reminder

status.description: ATTEMPTED, SENT, or FAILED delivery state

attempted_at.description: Server timestamp when the one delivery attempt began

sent_at.description: Server timestamp when the reminder was accepted for sending

error.description: Safe bounded delivery error without message content
